definitions.explanation: A hollow cylinder used for conveying fluids, gases, or as a structural component.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水道|すいどう}{管|かん}→水道管：08094_suidoukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}する→修理する：03214_shuuri⟧。
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{管|かん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漏|も}れている→漏れる：02435_moreru⟧。
examples.english: Water is leaking from the old pipe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧{管|かん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まった→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧。

notes:
{管|かん} refers to a hollow cylindrical object — a pipe, tube, or duct. Used both as a standalone word and as a suffix in compounds.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{水道|すいどう}{管|かん}→水道管：08094_suidoukan⟧: water pipe
- ⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧{管|かん}: sewer pipe
- ⟦{排水|はいすい}{管|かん}→排水管：23157_haisuikan⟧: drainage pipe
- {鉄|てつ}{管|かん}: iron pipe
- ⟦{血|けっ}{管|かん}→血管：02742_kekkan⟧: blood vessel
- ⟦{気|き}{管|かん}→気管：21172_kikan⟧: windpipe, trachea

CONTRAST WITH パイプ:
⟦パイプ→パイプ：00338_paipu⟧ (from English 'pipe') is used more casually and can also refer to smoking pipes or connections/channels (⟦パイプ→パイプ：00338_paipu⟧⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ = go-between). {管|かん} is more technical and appears mainly in compound words.

- ⟦{管轄|かんかつ}→管轄：13825_kankatsu⟧: jurisdiction
